description: This is a Java interface defining service methods for managing product attributes within a sales management system. It declares methods for saving/updating attributes and retrieving attributes based on various criteria such as option IDs, product IDs, and attribute IDs, utilizing associated models such as Product, MerchantStore, and Language.

classes.name: ProductAttributeService
classes.description: Java interface for product attribute management services, extending generic entity service and defining methods for CRUD and retrieval operations based on different attribute identifiers.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a ProductAttribute object, updating it if it already exists.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Returns a list of product attributes associated with a specific option ID within a store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves product attributes associated with a specific option value ID within a store.

methods.name: getByProductId
methods.description: Fetches product attributes associated with a specific product in a store, considering language for localization.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Returns product attributes corresponding to a list of attribute IDs within a store.
